home.metaTitle: Barcelona Airport Taxi | Book El Prat Transfers Online
home.metaDescription: Book a Barcelona airport taxi online in advance. Official AMB metered fares, fixed 20% booking fee, licensed black-and-yellow taxis to and from El Prat. 24 hours.
home.h1: Barcelona airport taxi, booked before you land
home.intro: Reserve a licensed black-and-yellow Barcelona taxi to or from El Prat airport. You see an accurate fare estimate from the official AMB tariff before you book, and you pay the driver the metered fare in the car — exactly as you would at the rank, but with a car already waiting for you.

meter.title: The official meter, nothing added
meter.body: Barcelona fares are set by the AMB and identical in every licensed taxi. We show you an accurate estimate from the real road distance, and you pay the meter — or lock a fixed price in advance if you prefer certainty.

flight.title: We watch your flight
flight.body: Your driver tracks your flight number. Land late and the car is still there, at no extra cost. Meeting point is in your confirmation email before you take off.

licensed.title: Licensed drivers only
licensed.body: Every vehicle is a licensed Barcelona taxi with a working meter and the insurance the city requires. No unlicensed cars, ever.

support.title: A person, not a queue
support.body: Message us on WhatsApp and you reach someone who can actually move your booking. Under three hours' notice, that is the fastest way to get a car.

pricing.metaDescription: Barcelona airport taxi prices explained: official AMB tariffs T-1 and T-2, the El Prat supplement, the 21 EUR airport minimum and our 20% booking fee.
pricing.intro: Barcelona taxi fares are not set by us. They are fixed by the Àrea Metropolitana de Barcelona (AMB) and run on the official meter in every licensed taxi. The table below is the current tariff, valid 19 January 2026 to 17 January 2027.

howItWorks.metaTitle: How Booking a Barcelona Airport Taxi Works
howItWorks.metaDescription: Book a Barcelona airport taxi in three steps: get an instant fare estimate, pay the 20% booking fee online, and pay the metered fare to your driver.

one.title: Get your estimate
one.body: Enter pickup and drop-off. We measure the real road distance and apply the official AMB tariff for your travel time to produce an accurate fare estimate.

two.title: Reserve the car
two.body: Choose your vehicle and pay the 20% booking fee online. Your booking is confirmed instantly by email, and a driver is assigned to you.

three.title: Pay the meter in the taxi
three.body: Your driver meets you at the agreed time. You pay the metered fare directly in the car, by cash or card, and can ask for the official taxi invoice.

faq.metaTitle: Barcelona Airport Taxi FAQ | Fares & Pickup
faq.metaDescription: Answers about Barcelona airport taxi bookings: how the fare is calculated, where to meet your driver at El Prat, luggage, invoices and cancellations.

fareAccurate.q: Is the price I see the price I pay?
fareAccurate.a: The figure we show is an accurate estimate built from the official AMB tariff and the real road distance of your route. The amount you actually pay is whatever the taxi meter shows at the end of the trip, which can vary slightly with traffic and the exact route taken. Our 20% booking fee is separate and is paid online when you reserve.

whyFee.q: Why is there a 20% booking fee?
whyFee.a: Barcelona taxi fares are fixed by the AMB, so no taxi can charge more or less than the meter. Our booking fee is a separate service charge for reserving and guaranteeing your car in advance, assigning a driver, and giving you tracking and support. It is shown to you before you pay and receipted separately.

invoice.a: Yes. The official invoice for the journey is the taxi meter invoice, which your driver will give you in the car on request. We email you a separate receipt for the booking fee.

meetDriver.q: Where do I meet my driver at El Prat?
meetDriver.a: Your driver waits in the arrivals hall of your terminal with a name sign, and follows your flight so a delay does not lose your car. The exact meeting point is in your confirmation email.

urgent.q: Can I book for the next hour?
urgent.a: Online bookings need at least three hours' notice so we can assign a driver reliably. For anything sooner, message us on WhatsApp and we will confirm a car directly if one is available.

luggage.q: How much luggage can I bring?
luggage.a: Each vehicle lists its passenger and bag capacity. A standard taxi takes up to 4 passengers and 3 bags; the Mercedes V-Class takes 7 passengers and 7 bags. If you are carrying oversized items such as bicycles or skis, tell us in the booking notes.

cancel.a: Yes. Cancel at least 24 hours before pickup and the booking fee is refunded in full. See our refund policy for the details.

outsideBarcelona.q: Do you pick up outside Barcelona?
outsideBarcelona.a: Not yet. At the moment pickups must be inside Barcelona city or at El Prat airport. Your destination, however, can be anywhere.
